name: Notion
description: Lets your agents read and write your Notion workspace — search pages, pull a doc's content as text, append notes, and query databases. Nothing to install; just connect a key.
author: Bakin

secrets.name: NOTION_TOKEN
secrets.description: Notion internal integration secret. Create an integration, copy its secret, then share each page or database you want agents to reach with that integration — Notion grants no access by default.
